caveats: This run used FAKE clients (in-memory stand-ins for S3/BDA/KB/embeddings/LLM).
Intent purity, cluster count and silhouette here are SMOKE-TEST values from a hashed-bag-of-words stand-in, not a semantic embedding model. Do NOT tune clustering parameters against them.

Fake-mode recall@5 is NOT evidence that the >=0.80 retrieval target is met. Real recall requires Bedrock embeddings (--mode aws) and a human-approved golden set; the committed golden_set.jsonl still contains placeholder rows.
synthetic_data_note: All metrics in this report are measured on SYNTHETIC data. They validate the pipeline, not real-world quality.
